2607.18068.title: Human Grounded Evaluation of Large Language Models for Optical Network Automation
2607.18068.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted for network automation, yet their output quality and inference cost can vary substantially across LLM families. We present HuGLEN, a stepwise evaluation pipeline that uses an LLM-as-a-judge together with a small set of expert ratings to enable scalable and reproducible comparison of candidate LLMs, and to rank them using a quality efficiency score (QES). We demonstrate HuGLEN for translating outputs from an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) model for the optical network quality of transmission (QoT) estimation task into operator-friendly explanations. Our results show that a medium-sized LLM (12B parameters) achieves the highest QES, indicating the best trade-off between explanation quality and efficiency. Overall, HuGLEN reduces the human-labeling burden while supporting consistent model selection for operator-facing automation tasks.
2607.18068.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在網絡自動化中的應用越來越普遍，但它們的輸出質量和推理成本在不同的LLM家族之間可能有很大差異。<lb/>我們提出了HuGLEN，一個逐步評估管道，利用LLM作為評判者，並結合一小組專家評分，以實現候選LLM的可擴展和可重複比較，並使用質量效率分數（QES）對它們進行排名。<lb/>我們展示了HuGLEN在將可解釋人工智慧（XAI）模型的光學網絡傳輸質量（QoT）估計任務的輸出轉換為操作員友好的解釋中的應用。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，一個中型LLM（12B參數）達到了最高的QES，表明了解釋質量和效率之間的最佳權衡。<lb/>總體而言，HuGLEN減少了人類標註的負擔，同時支持對面向操作員的自動化任務的一致模型選擇。
